checks.result: Lines by rarity are common/uncommon 0, rare 1, epic 2, legendary/immortal 3, supreme 4; farm drops, equipment gacha and fusion all produce that many lines with no repeated stat, values inside the pool range, and identical results for the same seed.

Options enter the shared equippedSources pipeline (used by Story battles and every preview) exactly once (opt_hp 0.05 at roll 1000, opt_crit 0.005 at roll 0); the pool has no attack_speed/cast_speed/AGI/DEX lines.
Tier-up 1→20 keeps the rolls and scales the value ×1.5; fusion re-rolls; migrating an old save gives stable lines (same result twice) that pass validateAccount.
Live: the backpack item sheet shows the ✦ option lines for pulled gear; equip-slot and change sheets use the same OptionLines component.

limitations: Option magnitudes are baselines; TASK-041 measures their effect. Simulation uses the same Story compile path (storyParty → equippedSources).
